about: The one place a form may differ from a node (reviews/form-parity.md, ADR-072): tools/forms_check.py runs tests/forms/*.slt on every form and fails on any difference these lists don't name.

forms.cluster: three nodes on one lake, each query spread over them
forms.inprocess: a node in the caller's process, through the library (Python's and JavaScript's connect(path))
forms.memory: a node in the caller's process on a lake in memory (connect() with no path, DuckDB's :memory:)
forms.page: the browser's form (web/pkg's Page), one thread and no lake

refusals.why: P1: a page's tables are DataFusion's MemTable, which keeps NOT NULL and DEFAULT only; kept on a page by rc.1 (the page's Keeper)
P2: DataFusion's INSERT takes no DEFAULT in VALUES; the column's default belongs in the core's write rules (rules::shape), as a node fills it
P4: enum types are the node's types stage (types.rs), which a page's Host leaves out

refusals.says: a page doesn't keep GENERATED ALWAYS AS
refusals.why: No form takes computed columns yet: a node refuses them with 42P16, a page with 0A000; one code for both

refusals.says: a page doesn't keep GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY
refusals.why: P1: as CHECK; kept on a page by rc.1
P4: `::jsonb` is rewritten by the node's types stage, reached through Host::types, whose default on a page changes nothing (front.rs)

refusals.says: a page doesn't keep PRIMARY KEY
refusals.why: P1: as CHECK; kept on a page by rc.1

refusals.says: a page keeps no table's past
refusals.why: P9: a page keeps each table's latest version only, with no log to read an older one from
A page has no transactions, and refuses BEGIN in DataFusion's words: a caller that goes on runs each statement on its own, so an UPDATE before ROLLBACK is kept
P1: as CHECK; kept on a page by rc.1
DECLARE $x is a node's step before its engine (vars.rs, server-only); a page's front never sees it

refusals.says: Inconsistent data length across values list
refusals.why: P2: a row narrower than its table takes the rest's defaults on a node (as in Postgres); DataFusion refuses it. The core's write rules (rules::shape)
DataFusion has no MERGE; a node's is write.rs's, which a page lacks
